title: Digging Deeper Into Django Migrations
description: Go beyond the basics of Django migrations: how they work under the hood, what the Django migrations table tracks, and what's inside migration files.
summary: You already understand the purpose of Django migrations and you’re familiar with fundamental usage patterns like creating and applying migrations. In this tutorial, you’ll dig deeper into the migration system and take a peek at some of its underlying mechanics, from the Django migrations table to the migration files themselves.
